description.value: The Oaklands Community Association is a neighbourhood association serving the Oaklands area of Victoria, bounded by Cook Street, Haultain Street, Shelbourne Street, and North Dairy Road. It operates from three locations — Oaklands Community Centre, Oaklands Neighbourhood House, and Hamilton Park — offering recreation programs, child care, a community garden, food security initiatives, and a seasonal Wednesday evening Sunset Market. The association is community-run and membership-based, with a broad range of programs for all ages.

The AGM notice on the website provides the address as #1-2827 Belmont Ave, and the phone number 250-370-9101 appears on multiple website subpages. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms for public use, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all amenity fields default to null.
